findings.why: Viteria Lanzo has no supplier id and appears in none of the documents, so it is not in our records. Its standing and qualification cannot be assessed. A person must confirm whether it is a known supplier.

sources.quote: three escapes to the Nordhavn line

findings.why: No controlled approval record covers Viteria Lanzo for HB-620, the receiving plant and the customer (Nordhavn is the customer named in the 8D). Absence of a record is not proof of non-approval, so this is a question for a person. Fonderia Dora's HB-620 approval was revoked on 2026-09-15, and the planned alternative was Fonderia Pellice after its audit and PPAP, not Lanzo.

sources.quote: A change of source requires a material certificate (EN 10204 type 3.1) from the new supplier for the drawing material.

findings.why: This is a change of source for HB-620, whose drawing material is MAT-ALSI9CU3. No 3.1 certificate from Viteria Lanzo is in the documents. QP-11 treats this as an open question for the supplier quality engineer.
